notes: Ground truth verified read-only against the 4a-DEMO_ALL demo account on 2026-10-08. All prompts name the account explicitly because several NetSuite connectors are attached in the test session.

evals.name: close-check-us-sep-dashboard
evals.prompt: Im Account 4a-DEMO_ALL: Ist der September 2026 für die Gesellschaft United States abschlussbereit? Prüf offene und ungenehmigte Belege und ob Debitoren und Kreditoren mit den Sammelkonten abstimmen. Bitte als Dashboard.
evals.expected_output: HTML dashboard with a close checklist for United States, Sep 2026, USD. Blocker: 4 journals pending approval. Attention: 3 item fulfillments picked not shipped, 6 sales orders pending billing, 1 PO pending bill / 6 pending receipt, 1 bill payment in transit. AR/AP subledger vs GL control accounts at 2026-09-30 (SuiteQL GL AR 636,280.12 / AP -151,120.52 USD; reports Trial Balance and Aging Summary AR 637,463.89 / AP 151,390.52 USD - the gap comes from documents not visible to SuiteQL) with differences explained. Period lock status reported as not determinable.
expectations: An .html dashboard file was produced in outputs/
The dashboard contains a source section (Quelle/Source) with at least one SuiteQL query
Reports exactly 4 journals pending approval in Sep 2026 for United States (not 15, which would be a line count)

Compares AR and AP subledger with the GL control accounts at 2026-09-30 and states the difference or that they tie. Accepted figures: SuiteQL GL AR 636,280.12 / AP -151,120.52 USD, or report-based AR 637,463.89 / AP 151,390.52 USD (the gap of 1,183.77 / 270.00 comes from documents this role cannot read via SuiteQL)
Does not claim the period is closed/locked; says period status is not readable/determinable
The final answer names 4a-DEMO_ALL
No call to ns_createRecord, ns_updateRecord, ns_executeRecordAction or ns_getRecordActionMetadata
No tool call to a Yepoda_* server; all NetSuite calls go to 4a-DEMO_ALL
